newsitem.title: UK: UK's C5 adds Arsenal to European soccer ranks.
newsitem.headline: UK's C5 adds Arsenal to European soccer ranks.

text.p: Britain's Channel 5 has acquired the rights to Arsenal's home matches in Europe's UEFA Cup in the coming season, a spokesman for the television company said on Tuesday.
The deal with the north London soccer club follows agreements with Aston Villa for their home UEFA Cup matches and Chelsea for Cup Winners' Cup matches at Stamford Bridge.
Channel 5 will look at acquiring the rights to the clubs' away European matches on a case by case basis, the spokesman said.

Channel 5, a national commercial television network launched in March, is using soccer as a means of building audience share and establishing itself. It has suffered from reception problems and gaps in its transmission area in its first few months.

Pearson Plc, one of its four shareholders, said on Monday the channel was "on track". It said the channel had achieved audience share of over three percent in July and has now been viewed in 62 percent of UK homes.
The channel, in which United News & Media Plc is also a shareholder, has set itself a target of five percent audience share by the end of the year.
